title: Arcane Octagonal Chamber
description: A top-down view of an intricate fantasy laboratory or ritual chamber featuring a glowing purple central octagonal pool with arcane symbols. The room contains four circular pedestals, multiple glowing teal crystals, bookshelves, wooden tables, and mechanical wall fixtures, all connected by luminous golden lines on the floor.
prompt: Top-down isometric view of a mystical arcane laboratory with a glowing purple octagonal central pool containing magical runes and symbols. Four stone pedestals surround the pool, connected by luminous golden lines on the terracotta floor. The chamber includes wooden bookshelves, tables with alchemical equipment, glowing teal crystals in corners, mechanical wall devices, and arched windows. Fantasy game art style with intricate details and atmospheric lighting.
